description:
How news moved a specific company/asset (incl commodities like GOLD.COMM) — per-article impact
    (direction + aspect + why), most recent first. Near-duplicate stories are MERGED by default (each row
    = one story + `dup_count`); `collapse=false` for the raw feed. `limit` = how many (default 20, max 50). Ordered by how hard each story hits this entity (`relevance`, 1.0 = directly about it; a market wrap that touches it ranks lower), then recency; `companies_in_story` says when it is one of several
    — heavily-covered assets have HUNDREDS, so keep it small + narrow. TIME-SCOPE with `from_`/`to` (ISO)
    or `window` ('90d','qtd','1y'); to COMPARE periods, call once per period. ⚠️ News starts 2026-01-01 —
    older ranges return nothing (no coverage, not 'no news'; price/volatility history goes back decades).
    🔵 BONDS/RATES: a specific tenor/rate (`US-2Y.GB`, `SOFR.MM`) with no news of its own returns the
    country's benchmark-10Y macro news tagged `scope:'curve_macro'` + `macro_source` — narrate those as
    curve-wide central-bank context, not tenor-specific. 📏 MAGNITUDE: for a listed, priced asset each story has
    `price_move` = close-to-close % of the session it landed in (`day_pct`) and of the next one (`next_day_pct`) —
    the market's reaction next to the direction. It is the WHOLE day's move (other news counts too), not the story's
    isolated effect; say so. End-of-day prices: a story from today has no session close yet.

collapse.description: Merge near-duplicate stories (same article from many outlets) into one row + `dup_count`. Default ON; pass `false` for the raw un-deduped feed.
collapse.title: Collapse

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

country.description: OPTIONAL market disambiguator — pass ONLY when `ticker` is a plain NAME that collides across markets (the Thai vs Korean 'KBANK'); omit for a distinctive name or an exact ticker (an unneeded country silently 0-matches). A country NAME or ISO-2 code ('South Korea'/'KR'); the server normalizes, so pass the NAME when unsure — never GUESS a 2-letter code ('CH' = Switzerland, not China).
country.title: Country

direction.description: Filter by impact direction: `pos` | `neg` | `ambiguous`. Omit → all.
direction.title: Direction

from_.description: Lower time bound, ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. ⚠️ Ava Advisor NEWS coverage starts 2026-01-01 (nothing before).
from_.title: From

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

ticker.description: A Ava Advisor ticker OR a company/asset NAME — the SERVER resolves it (no lookup step). A COMPANY/proper NAME passes AS-IS in any language (茅台/トヨタ/삼성 resolve natively — never translate a name); a generic COMMODITY/SECTOR concept must be ENGLISH (黄金→'gold', 原油→'crude oil'). Pass the user's full request in `context` to disambiguate ('apple' company vs fruit); if still ambiguous you get a `needs_confirmation` with candidates — resolve from conversation or ask, then re-call. Exact tickers pass through (Ava Advisor suffixes: Korea .KO, Taiwan .TW, commodity .COMM, crypto .CC, FX .FOREX, bond .GB, rate .MM).
ticker.title: Ticker

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window
